scope: Sources used to define a denominator and explain why an industry-wide percentage is not available.

sources.title: A Framework for Automated Driving System Testable Cases and Scenarios
sources.publisher: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
sources.evidence: NHTSA describes a preliminary framework for testable cases and scenarios for ADS features and operational design domains.
sources.use_in_model: Supports a structured test-case denominator rather than a raw road-mile percentage.
sources.boundary: Framework and example cases; it does not publish a universal industry coverage numerator/denominator.

sources.title: ISO 34502:2022 Road vehicles - Test scenarios for automated driving systems - Scenario-based safety evaluation framework
sources.evidence: The framework is scenario-based and is applied during ADS product development; it defines a process rather than one fixed global scenario list.
sources.use_in_model: Supports reporting coverage against an explicitly declared scenario catalog.
sources.boundary: Standard guidance is not an industry census and does not validate the project's 15% starting point.

sources.title: Scenario Database / PEGASUS method material
sources.evidence: PEGASUS presents a six-layer model and a database/data-processing chain for relevant scenarios and parameter distributions.
sources.use_in_model: Supports decomposing coverage by road, traffic, environment, and actor layers.
sources.boundary: Project methodology and catalog design, not a measured industry-wide coverage rate.

sources.title: Coverage Metrics for a Scenario Database for the Scenario-Based Assessment of Automated Driving Systems
sources.evidence: The paper illustrates coverage metrics with more than 200,000 scenarios from 10 scenario categories and shows that 100% coverage can be obtained under a specified definition and reference set.
sources.use_in_model: Demonstrates that coverage is denominator- and metric-dependent; use a declared reference catalog and report per-dimension coverage.
sources.boundary: An illustrative dataset experiment, not an industry baseline and not evidence that this project's 21 signatures represent all ADS scenarios.
